description: Query live Atlassian Marketplace pricing, licenses, transactions and revenue cohorts for the ZenUML apps. Use for seat-based prices, monthly/annual quotes, vendor share, renewal windows, overdue candidates, top customers and portfolio rollups. Separates recorded purchases from source-reported payment and vendor payout; Open orders are not absent purchases. Use mp_pricing.py for prices and take rates, and mp_report.py for bulk exports, scoped license/transaction joins and local snapshots. For one tenant's status, profile or trial expiry use tenant, which reuses this engine; one tenant's price still belongs here. Use mp_listing.py for listing visibility: Marketplace search-keyword reports (search appearances of our apps, demand share of terms) and website search rank.
